title: LGTM Grafana Stack: OpenTelemetry Tracing for API & Database Spans
comment_samples: Great video, thank you for diving into the details. Especially that query link!
Awesome! Thanks a lot for sharing.
description:
Discover the power of the LGTM stack (Loki, Grafana, Tempo, Mimir)! In this video, I’ll demonstrate:

Using Grafana to process app logs from Loki.
Building visuals from application metrics stored in Mimir (Prometheus).
Leveraging Tempo metrics with data links to traces.
Tracing slow spans to pinpoint API and database performance issues with Tempo.

Watch as I break down each span for precise insights into your system. Perfect for modern monitoring and troubleshooting!

👉 Learn to optimize your stack with OpenTelemetry tracing!
